verse.unicode: ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: kit kit bidh jag upajai purakhaa kit kit dhukh binas jaiee ||

en.bdb: "How, in what way, was the world formed, O man? And what disaster will end it?"

verse.unicode: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: haumai vich jag upajai purakhaa naam visariaai dhukh paiee ||

en.bdb: In egotism, the world was formed, O man; forgetting the Naam, it suffers and dies.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh hovai su giaan tat beechaarai haumai sabadh jalaae ||

en.bdb: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; through the Shabad, he burns away his egotism.

verse.unicode: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥

transliteration.english: tan man niramal niramal baanee saachai rahai samaae ||

en.bdb: His body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Bani of the Word. He remains absorbed in Truth.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥

transliteration.english: naame naam rahai bairaagee saach rakhiaa ur dhaare ||

en.bdb: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he remains detached; he enshrines the True Name in his heart.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬੮॥

transliteration.english: naanak bin naavai jog kadhe na hovai dhekhahu ridhai beechaare ||68||

en.bdb: O Nanak, without the Name, Yoga is never attained; reflect upon this in your heart, and see. ||68||

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh saach sabadh beechaarai koi ||

en.bdb: The Gurmukh is one who reflects upon the True Word of the Shabad.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh sach baanee paragaT hoi ||

en.bdb: The True Bani is revealed to the Gurmukh.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh man bheejai viralaa boojhai koi ||

en.bdb: The mind of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord's Love, but how rare are those who understand this.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||

en.bdb: The Gurmukh dwells in the home of the self, deep within.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh jogee jugat pachhaanai ||

en.bdb: The Gurmukh realizes the Way of Yoga.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੬੯॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh naanak eko jaanai ||69||

en.bdb: O Nanak, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord alone. ||69||

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: bin satigur seve jog na hoiee ||

en.bdb: Without serving the True Guru, Yoga is not attained;

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: bin satigur bheTe mukat na koiee ||

en.bdb: without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥

transliteration.english: bin satigur bheTe naam paiaa na jai ||

en.bdb: Without meeting the True Guru, the Naam cannot be found.

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥

transliteration.english: bin satigur bheTe mahaa dhukh pai ||

en.bdb: Without meeting the True Guru, one suffers in terrible pain.

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥

transliteration.english: bin satigur bheTe mahaa garab gubaar ||

en.bdb: Without meeting the True Guru, there is only the deep darkness of egotistical pride.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੭੦॥

transliteration.english: naanak bin gur muaa janam haar ||70||

en.bdb: O Nanak, without the True Guru, one dies, having lost the opportunity of this life. ||70||

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh man jeetaa haumai maar ||

en.bdb: The Gurmukh conquers his mind by subduing his ego.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh saach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||

en.bdb: The Gurmukh enshrines Truth in his heart.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh jag jeetaa jamakaal maar bidhaar ||

en.bdb: The Gurmukh conquers the world; he knocks down the Messenger of Death, and kills it.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh dharageh na aavai haar ||

en.bdb: The Gurmukh does not lose in the Court of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh mel milaae suo jaanai ||

en.bdb: The Gurmukh is united in God's Union; he alone knows.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੭੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak gurmukh sabadh pachhaanai ||71||

en.bdb: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad. ||71||

verse.unicode: ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: sabadhai kaa nibeRaa sun too aaudhoo bin naavai jog na hoiee ||

en.bdb: This is the essence of the Shabad - listen, you hermits and Yogis. Without the Name, there is no Yoga.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: naame raate anadhin maate naamai te sukh hoiee ||

en.bdb: Those who are attuned to the Name, remain intoxicated night and day; through the Name, they find peace.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: naamai hee te sabh paragaT hovai naame sojhee paiee ||

en.bdb: Through the Name, everything is revealed; through the Name, understanding is obtained.

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥

transliteration.english: bin naavai bhekh kareh bahutere sachai aap khuaaiee ||

en.bdb: Without the Name, people wear all sorts of religious robes; the True Lord Himself has confused them.

verse.unicode: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: satigur te naam paieeaai aaudhoo jog jugat taa hoiee ||

en.bdb: The Name is obtained only from the True Guru, O hermit, and then, the Way of Yoga is found.

verse.unicode: ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭੨॥

transliteration.english: kar beechaar man dhekhahu naanak bin naavai mukat na hoiee ||72||

en.bdb: Reflect upon this in your mind, and see; O Nanak, without the Name, there is no liberation. ||72||

verse.unicode: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥

transliteration.english: teree gat mit toohai jaaneh kiaa ko aakh vakhaanai ||

en.bdb: You alone know Your state and extent, Lord; What can anyone say about it?

verse.unicode: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥

transliteration.english: too aape gupataa aape paragaT aape sabh ra(n)g maanai ||

en.bdb: You Yourself are hidden, and You Yourself are revealed. You Yourself enjoy all pleasures.

verse.unicode: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੈ ॥

transliteration.english: saadhik sidh guroo bahu chele khojat fireh furamaanai ||

en.bdb: The seekers, the Siddhas, the many gurus and disciples wander around searching for You, according to Your Will.

verse.unicode: ਮਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਇਹ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥

transliteration.english: maageh naam pai ieh bhikhiaa tere dharasan kau kurabaanai ||

en.bdb: They beg for Your Name, and You bless them with this charity. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verse.unicode: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: abinaasee prabh khel rachaiaa gurmukh sojhee hoiee ||

en.bdb: The eternal imperishable Lord God has staged this play; the Gurmukh understands it.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭਿ ਜੁਗ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭੩॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak sabh jug aape varatai dhoojaa avar na koiee ||73||1||

en.bdb: O Nanak, He extends Himself throughout the ages; there is no other than Him. ||73||1||
